MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.description: Modifier stacking uses TWO separate pools that never cross-apply. Prep tasks use condition_scale x door_style x height (frame tasks) x kitchen_complexity (frame/protection tasks). Coating tasks use quality_tier x door_style x height (frame tasks) x kitchen_complexity (frame/protection tasks). Condition drives prep intensity; QT drives coating quality. Pools NEVER mix.
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.worst_case_prep: POOR(2.50) x raised_panel(1.30) x extra_tall(1.30) x very_complex(1.30) = 5.49x — exceeds 4.0x but extremely rare; flag for estimator review
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.worst_case_coating: QT5(1.50) x raised_panel(1.30) x extra_tall(1.30) x very_complex(1.30) = 3.29x — under 4.0x, valid
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.realistic_max_prep: POOR(2.50) x raised_panel(1.30) x tall_9_10ft(1.15) x standard(1.10) = 4.11x — flag for review
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.realistic_max_coating: QT5(1.50) x raised_panel(1.30) x extra_tall(1.30) = 2.54x (frames) or 1.95x (doors)

prep_tasks.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (condition_scale x door_style x height x kitchen_complexity)
prep_tasks.notes: door_style applies to door/drawer tasks only. height and kitchen_complexity apply to frame/protection tasks only. These never overlap on the same task.

coating_tasks.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (quality_tier x door_style x height x kitchen_complexity)

task_production_rates.name: Install full kitchen floor protection for spray
task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_PROTECT_FLOOR_FULL (250 SF/hr). Canvas drop cloths + tape edges. Full room coverage for spray method.

task_production_rates.name: Install perimeter floor protection for brush
task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_PROTECT_FLOOR_PERIM (200 SF/hr). Drop cloth runners at cabinet base only.

task_production_rates.name: Protect countertop surfaces
task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_PROTECT_COUNTERTOP (90 SF/hr). Kraft/rosin paper + tape + plastic sheeting. CRITICAL: high-value surfaces.

task_production_rates.name: Mask backsplash
task_production_rates.notes: LF/hr. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_PROTECT_BACKSPLASH (50 LF/hr). Green tape edge seal against tile.

task_production_rates.name: Mask walls for spray overspray
task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_PROTECT_WALL (125 SF/hr). Plastic sheeting taped to walls. In RP, walls are ALWAYS finished — masking is mandatory.

task_production_rates.name: Mask ceiling for spray overspray
task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_PROTECT_CEILING (125 SF/hr). Plastic sheeting + pre-taped masking film.

task_production_rates.name: Mask and protect appliances
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. DIRECT rate from NC TSK_CABT_PROTECT_APPLIANCE (3 EA/hr, ~15-25 min per appliance). MODIFIED scope: was conditional in NC, ALWAYS required in RP — appliances are always present in occupied homes.

task_production_rates.name: Mask sink plumbing in base cabinet
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per room. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_PROTECT_PLUMBING (15 min). Plastic wrap around plumbing fixtures.

task_production_rates.name: Remove switch plates and mask electrical
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per room. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_PROTECT_ELECTRICAL (15 min). Remove outlet/switch plates, mask under-cabinet lights.

task_production_rates.name: Verify all cabinet contents removed by homeowner
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per room. RP-NEW. Walk all cabinets to verify homeowner has emptied contents. Check uppers, lowers, drawers, pantry. Any remaining items must be removed and staged.

task_production_rates.name: Score paint, remove all cabinet hardware, bag, label
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr (hardware pieces). MODIFIED from NC TSK_CABT_REMOVE_HARDWARE (35 EA/hr). RP hardware is painted over — must score paint around hinges/screws before removal. ~30% slower than NC. May require screw extractor for stripped screws. ~2.5 min per piece.

task_production_rates.name: Remove cabinet doors and label
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_REMOVE_DOORS (18 EA/hr). ~3-4 min per door. Removal technique identical once hardware is removed.

task_production_rates.name: Remove cabinet drawers and label
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_REMOVE_DRAWERS (22 EA/hr). ~2.5-3 min per drawer.

task_production_rates.name: Visual condition inspection — all cabinet components
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per room. RP-NEW. Systematic visual inspection of all cabinet surfaces: frames, doors, drawers, interiors (if in scope). Document condition per component. QT3: standard scan with work light. QT4: systematic with raking light + photos. QT5: exhaustive, multiple passes, full documentation. Calibrated from door RP TSK_DIRP_ASSESS_CONDITION (7-15 min per opening) scaled for room-level cabinet assessment.

task_production_rates.name: Adhesion test — ASTM D3359 cross-hatch tape test
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per room. RP-NEW. CRITICAL for cabinets. Test minimum 3 locations per room: one upper door, one lower door, one frame section. Diverse existing finish types demand adhesion verification. Calibrated from door RP TSK_DIRP_ASSESS_ADHESION (7-8 min per opening) — cabinet tests 3 representative locations per room.

task_production_rates.name: Coating identification — solvent test for existing finish type
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per room. RP-NEW. Solvent test to identify existing coating type (painted_latex, painted_oil, lacquer, catalyzed_varnish, thermofoil). Cabinet coating ID is more complex than doors/trim (5 possible finish types vs 2). Test at minimum 2 locations per room. Results drive primer routing.

task_production_rates.name: Moisture check — base cabinets and bath vanity
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per room. RP-NEW. Moisture meter reading on base cabinet floor, back wall, sides. Check under-sink and dishwasher-adjacent. Active moisture is STOP WORK condition. Calibrated from door RP TSK_DIRP_ASSESS_MOISTURE (4 min per opening) — cabinets need multiple check points per room.

task_production_rates.name: Thermofoil assessment gate — paintability determination
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per room. RP-NEW. Conditional on thermofoil presence. Inspect all door/drawer edges, corners, heat-exposed areas (near oven, dishwasher) for vinyl lifting/bubbling/delamination. ANY delamination = not paintable — recommend replacement. GO/NO-GO documented with photos. Cabinet-specific gate.

task_production_rates.name: Lead paint screening — pre-1978 homes
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per room. RP-NEW. XRF or swab test. Cabinets are HIGH RISK for lead (oil-based enamel standard through 1970s). Test minimum 2 locations per room (1 door, 1 frame). If positive, triggers MOD_RRP_INT_CONTAINMENT.

task_production_rates.name: Lead Test (XRF or Swab)
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr (rooms). Shared RRP module task. Test at minimum 1 door + 1 frame per room. ~7-8 min per room. Rate from door RP TSK_DIRP_ASSESS_LEAD pattern.

task_production_rates.name: RRP Containment Setup
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr (rooms). Shared RRP module. Poly sheeting on floors and openings, warning signs, restrict entry. ~30 min per room. Kitchen containment is complex due to multiple openings, appliances, ventilation. Rate from door RP RRP containment pattern.

task_production_rates.name: HEPA Vacuum After Paint Disturbance
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr (rooms). Shared RRP module. HEPA vacuum all surfaces after each sanding/scraping disturbance. ~15 min per room. Runs after each prep disturbance activity.

task_production_rates.name: RRP Containment Removal and Visual Clearance
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr (rooms). Shared RRP module. Remove containment, visual clearance inspection. ~20 min per room.

task_production_rates.name: Lead-Contaminated Waste Disposal
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per job. Shared RRP module. Package and dispose of lead-contaminated debris per EPA RRP Rule.

task_production_rates.name: TSP/degreaser wash — kitchen grease removal
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per room. MODIFIED from NC TSK_CABT_DUST_CLEAN (25 min). RP grease wash is fundamentally different: TSP/degreaser, multiple passes above range/cooktop, white cloth verification. ~1.6x NC dust clean time. Kitchen_complexity modifier applies (more cabinets = more grease accumulation).

task_production_rates.name: Degloss face frames and box surfaces

QT3.notes: Thorough mechanical degloss 120-150 grit on existing finish. Heavier grit than NC sand.

QT4.notes: Full degloss with adhesion verification, profile details addressed.

QT5.notes: Complete degloss with verification, spot adhesion re-test.

task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr. MODIFIED from NC TSK_CABT_SAND_FRAMES (QT3: 175 SF/hr). RP degloss ~0.80x NC sand rate — harder existing finish, coarser grit (120-150 vs 180-220). Narrow frame members require careful hand work.

task_production_rates.name: Degloss cabinet doors

QT4.notes: Full degloss with adhesion verification, panel recesses addressed.

QT5.notes: Complete degloss, all panel detail areas.

task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. MODIFIED from NC TSK_CABT_SAND_DOORS (QT3: 18 EA/hr). RP degloss ~0.78x NC sand rate. Flat on sawhorses. door_style modifier applies (raised_panel recesses trap existing finish).

task_production_rates.name: Degloss cabinet drawer fronts
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. MODIFIED from NC TSK_CABT_SAND_DRAWERS (QT3: 24 EA/hr). RP degloss ~0.75x NC sand rate. ~0.7x door degloss time (smaller surface). door_style modifier applies.

task_production_rates.name: Degloss cabinet interior surfaces
task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr. RP-NEW. Light scuff degloss on cabinet interiors. Always QT3 effort level regardless of exterior tier. Interior surfaces less exposed — light 220-grit scuff sufficient. Binary (not qt_scaled) because always QT3.

task_production_rates.name: Chemical degloss — liquid sander for profiled doors/drawers
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr (doors + drawers combined). RP-NEW. Supplemental to mechanical degloss — profile areas only. Apply liquid sander/deglosser (Wilbond, Krud Kutter Gloss-Off) to raised panel recesses, shaker inside corners. NOT for thermofoil (solvents damage vinyl). ~6 min per door/drawer.

task_production_rates.name: Scrape loose/failing paint to sound substrate
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per room. RP-NEW. Condition-gated (FAIR/POOR). Scrape all loose, cracking, delaminating paint from frames, doors, drawers. Careful on profiled doors. HEPA vacuum if RRP active. QT5 exhaustive scraping with zero tolerance for loose edges.

task_production_rates.name: Feather-sand scrape edges for smooth transition
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per room. RP-NEW. Non-negotiable at all tiers — cabinet finishes are scrutinized at arm's length. 150-180 grit feather sanding. Condition-gated (FAIR/POOR). Ridge telegraphing through semi-gloss/gloss is unacceptable.

task_production_rates.name: Repair surface damage — dings, scratches, impact damage
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per room. RP-NEW. Replaces NC fill tasks (TSK_CABT_FILL_FRAMES/DOORS/DRAWERS which are NOT_APPLICABLE in RP). Fill dings, scratches, impact marks, hardware relocation holes. Lightweight spackle or wood filler. Includes sand-flush. Condition-gated.

task_production_rates.name: Sand filled/repaired areas smooth
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per room. DIRECT technique from NC TSK_CABT_SAND_FILL (QT3: 10 min). Sanding filled areas is identical NC or RP. Slightly longer in RP (12 min) because RP damage repairs may include deeper fills. Condition-gated.

task_production_rates.name: Assess and replace failed caulk — cabinet-to-wall joints

QT3.notes: Walk-and-assess, replace visibly failed sections (~15-20% of joints).

QT4.notes: Comprehensive assessment, replace all suspect and failed joints (~25-35%).

QT5.notes: Critical assessment, replace all joints not in perfect condition (~40-50%), perfect tooled bead.

task_production_rates.notes: LF/hr. MODIFIED from NC TSK_CABT_CAULK_JOINTS (QT3: 80 LF/hr full caulk). RP is faster per LF because walk-and-assess replaces only failed sections (15-30% typical). NC applied new caulk to ALL joints. RP QT3 ~1.38x NC QT3 rate.

task_production_rates.name: Biocide treatment for mildew/mold — under-sink and bath vanity
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per room. RP-NEW. Conditional on moisture damage + mildew. Apply biocide, allow dwell time, rinse/wipe per product. Source must be resolved before treatment.

task_production_rates.name: Smoke/nicotine pre-treatment wash
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per room. RP-NEW. Conditional on smoke damage. Heavy TSP wash to remove surface nicotine/smoke film before shellac stain blocker. Kitchen cabinets may have combined grease + smoke. May require multiple passes.

task_production_rates.name: Vacuum floor after prep work
task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_VACUUM_FLOOR (300 SF/hr). HEPA vacuum for dust control — critical in kitchen environment.

task_production_rates.name: Spray primer on face frames and box surfaces
task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr. DIRECT rate from NC TSK_CABT_PRIME_FRAMES spray method (225 SF/hr). Application technique identical. Primer chemistry changed: RP uses state-driven + factory-finish-type-driven routing (4 systems) vs NC substrate-driven (7 systems). Rate is product-independent.

task_production_rates.name: Brush primer on face frames and box surfaces
task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr. DIRECT rate from NC TSK_CABT_PRIME_FRAMES brush method (115 SF/hr). Roll and Tip per FFD SS15.6.

task_production_rates.name: Spray primer on cabinet doors (flat on sawhorses)
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. DIRECT rate from NC TSK_CABT_PRIME_DOORS spray method (13 EA/hr). HVLP spray, face and edges. Horizontal gravity-assisted leveling. door_style modifier applies.

task_production_rates.name: Brush primer on cabinet doors (flat on sawhorses)
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. DIRECT rate from NC TSK_CABT_PRIME_DOORS brush method (7 EA/hr). Roll and Tip. door_style modifier applies.

task_production_rates.name: Spray primer on drawer fronts (flat on sawhorses)
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. DIRECT rate from NC TSK_CABT_PRIME_DRAWERS spray method (18 EA/hr). ~0.7x door time. door_style modifier applies.

task_production_rates.name: Brush primer on drawer fronts (flat on sawhorses)
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. DIRECT rate from NC TSK_CABT_PRIME_DRAWERS brush method (10 EA/hr). Roll and Tip. door_style modifier applies.

task_production_rates.name: Spray primer on cabinet interiors
task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr. DIRECT rate from NC TSK_CABT_PRIME_INTERIOR (175 SF/hr). Spray-only in practice. Always QT3. Angle gun into cabinet box, work back wall forward.

task_production_rates.name: Post-primer adhesion test — verify bonding
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per room. RP-NEW. Quality gate for bonding/adhesion primers. Tape test at minimum 2 primed locations per room. CRITICAL when bonding primer used on factory lacquer/thermofoil. Failure = STOP WORK.

task_production_rates.name: Clean work area between coats
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per interstage cycle. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_CLEAN_AREA (10 min). Remove dust and debris from floor protection, countertop covers, sawhorse area.

task_production_rates.name: Inspect previous coat for defects
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per interstage cycle. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_INSPECT_COAT. QT3: quick scan at 6 ft. QT4: systematic 3-ft inspection, mark defects. QT5: lighted critical inspection at arm's length, zero tolerance.

task_production_rates.name: Sand between coats on frames

QT5.notes: Thorough full sand 220-320 grit, uniform scratch.

task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr per interstage cycle. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_SAND_BETWEEN_FRAMES. Once coated, interstage sanding is product-driven not substrate-driven — identical NC and RP.

task_production_rates.name: Sand between coats on doors
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr per interstage cycle. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_SAND_BETWEEN_DOORS. door_style modifier applies.

task_production_rates.name: Sand between coats on drawers
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr per interstage cycle. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_SAND_BETWEEN_DRAWERS. ~0.7x door time. door_style modifier applies.

task_production_rates.name: Sand between coats on interiors
task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr per interstage cycle. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_SAND_BETWEEN_INTERIOR (150 SF/hr). Always QT3 — spot sand only. Awkward interior access. NOTE: qt_scaled in SOP for structural consistency but effectively single-rate because always QT3.

task_production_rates.name: Patch and repair interstage defects
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per interstage cycle. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_PATCH_DEFECTS. Fill, sand, spot-prime defects. Scope increases with tier.

task_production_rates.name: Spot coat patched areas
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per interstage cycle. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_SPOT_COAT. Touch-up patched areas to match surrounding finish.

task_production_rates.name: Tack cloth all surfaces before next coat
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per interstage cycle. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_TACK_CLEAN (15 min). Remove all sanding dust. Frames, doors, drawers, interiors (if in scope).

task_production_rates.name: Spray finish coat on frames
task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_SPRAY_FRAMES (200 SF/hr). HVLP or fine-finish airless. Horizontal rails first, then vertical stiles. Once surface is prepped/primed, finish application is identical NC and RP.

task_production_rates.name: Brush finish coat on frames (Roll and Tip)
task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_BRUSH_FRAMES (105 SF/hr). 2-2.5 inch angled sash brush. Roll and Tip per FFD SS15.6. Waterborne alkyd STRONGLY recommended.

task_production_rates.name: Spray finish coat on doors
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_SPRAY_DOORS (11 EA/hr). Flat on sawhorses — gravity-assisted leveling. ~5-6 min per door. door_style modifier applies.

task_production_rates.name: Brush finish coat on doors (Roll and Tip)
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_BRUSH_DOORS (6 EA/hr). Roll and Tip per FFD SS15.6. Thin to Win per SS15.11.3. ~10 min per door. door_style modifier applies.

task_production_rates.name: Spray finish coat on drawer fronts
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_SPRAY_DRAWERS (15 EA/hr). ~0.7x door time. door_style modifier applies.

task_production_rates.name: Brush finish coat on drawer fronts (Roll and Tip)
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_BRUSH_DRAWERS (8 EA/hr). Roll and Tip. ~0.7x door time. door_style modifier applies.

task_production_rates.name: Spray finish coat on interiors
task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_SPRAY_INTERIOR (150 SF/hr). Always QT3 regardless of exterior tier (AWI semi-exposed standard). Spray-only. NOTE: qt_scaled in SOP but effectively single-rate because always QT3.

task_production_rates.name: Final quality inspection per tier
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per room. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_FINAL_INSPECT. QT3: quick scan ambient light. QT4: systematic 3-ft with work light. QT5: critical inspection at arm's length, every door and drawer.

task_production_rates.name: Touch-up defects from final inspection
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per room. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_TOUCHUP. Correct remaining defects, feather into surrounding finish.

task_production_rates.name: Cure period — doors stored safely
task_production_rates.notes: Calendar days, NOT work hours. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_CURE_PERIOD. MANDATORY 5-7 day minimum. 7-14 days for waterborne alkyd (QT4). Doors stored safely, not touching. Engine flags scheduling constraint.

task_production_rates.name: Reinstall doors, verify alignment and operation
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_REINSTALL_DOORS (10 EA/hr). ~6 min per door. Hang, adjust hinges, check swing. RP may need hinge mortise cleaning for paint build-up from multiple repaint cycles.

task_production_rates.name: Reinstall drawers, check slides and operation
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_REINSTALL_DRAWERS (14 EA/hr). ~4 min per drawer. Reinstall on slides, verify soft-close.

task_production_rates.name: Reinstall all cabinet hardware
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_REINSTALL_HARDWARE (25 EA/hr). ~2.5 min per piece. RP: clean paint from screw holes and hinge mortises. Account for paint build-up thickness.

task_production_rates.name: Adjust hinge alignment after reinstall
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr (per door). RP-NEW. Fine-tune alignment after reinstallation. Paint film thickness changes hinge geometry. Check door-to-frame reveal uniformity. Adjust Euro hinge screws or shim traditional hinges. ~4 min per door. More critical in RP than NC due to accumulated paint thickness.

task_production_rates.name: Touch-up after reinstallation
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per room. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_REINSTALL_TOUCHUP. Touch-up hinge areas, pull/knob mounting points, handling damage from reinstallation.

task_production_rates.name: Coordinate cabinet contents replacement with homeowner
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per room. RP-NEW. Verify cabinets are clean, dry, and ready for contents. Advise homeowner to wait 24-48 hrs before heavy loading. Painter does NOT replace contents (homeowner responsibility).

task_production_rates.name: Customer walkthrough and completion review
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per room. RP-NEW. Walk through with homeowner, inspect every door and drawer face, demonstrate operation/alignment/soft-close, identify touch-up needs, leave touch-up paint. Cabinet walkthrough is more thorough than wall/trim — homeowner inspects every door individually.

task_production_rates.name: Remove countertop protection
task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_REMOVE_COUNTERTOP_PROTECT (120 SF/hr). Careful removal to avoid adhesive residue on stone surfaces.

task_production_rates.name: Remove backsplash masking
task_production_rates.notes: LF/hr. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_REMOVE_BACKSPLASH_MASK (80 LF/hr). Score tape edge, pull at 45 degrees.

task_production_rates.name: Remove wall masking
task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_REMOVE_WALL_MASK (180 SF/hr). Remove plastic sheeting, fold inward.

task_production_rates.name: Remove ceiling masking
task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_REMOVE_CEILING_MASK (180 SF/hr). Remove plastic sheeting.

task_production_rates.name: Remove appliance protection
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_REMOVE_APPLIANCE_MASK (5 EA/hr). ~12 min per appliance. Remove plastic wrap and tape.

task_production_rates.name: Remove floor protection
task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_REMOVE_FLOOR_PROTECT (300 SF/hr). Fold inward to contain debris. Covers both spray (full) and brush (perimeter).

task_production_rates.name: Final vacuum of work area
task_production_rates.notes: SF/hr. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_VACUUM_FINAL (300 SF/hr). Floor area after all protection removed. Include inside cabinet boxes — dust settles during cure period.

task_production_rates.name: Clean tools and equipment
task_production_rates.notes: FIXED per session. DIRECT from NC TSK_CABT_TOOL_CLEANUP (20 min). Clean brushes, rollers, spray equipment. Water cleanup for waterborne. Solvent cleanup for shellac primer residue.

condition_scale_modifier.applies_to: Prep-phase tasks (degloss, scrape, feather, damage repair, grease wash). PREP pool only.
condition_scale_modifier.does_not_apply_to: Finish tasks, interstage tasks, protection tasks, assessment tasks, cleanup tasks. NEVER in COATING pool.

GOOD.description: Minimal prep — sound paint, cosmetic refresh.

FAIR.description: Targeted repair — scrape failing areas, feather, spot prime.

POOR.description: Full remediation — extensive scrape, full feathering, comprehensive repair.

condition_scale_modifier.application_rule: TIME modifier. effective_rate = base_rate / condition_scale. Applies to qt_scaled prep tasks. Binary prep tasks are gated by condition (applies_when) rather than modified.
condition_scale_modifier.notes: Cabinet POOR is 2.5x (higher than wall/trim 2.0x) because cabinet failure remediation involves 4 item types across different orientations (frames vertical, doors/drawers horizontal).

door_style_modifier.source: Research: CD-007 door_style. DIRECT transfer from NC MOD_CABT_DOOR_STYLE.

slab.description: Flat panel — simplest to prep and paint.

shaker.description: Recessed panel with square-profile frame. Moderate degloss complexity.

raised_panel.description: Most complex. Recessed areas trap existing finish, difficult to degloss mechanically.

glass_frame.description: Frame only (glass removed or masked). Narrow members.

door_style_modifier.application_rule: TIME modifier. adjusted_hours = base_hours * door_style_value. Applies to door AND drawer tasks equally.

quality_tier_modifier.source: Research: CD-002 quality_tier. DIRECT transfer from NC MOD_CABT_QUALITY_TIER.
quality_tier_modifier.applies_to: qt_scaled tasks in COATING pool (finish, interstage). For tasks with rates_by_tier, the tiered rate already embeds QT — do NOT double-apply.
quality_tier_modifier.does_not_apply_to: binary tasks, prep pool tasks, protection tasks, assessment tasks. For tasks WITH rates_by_tier or fixed_time_minutes_by_tier, QT is pre-embedded.
quality_tier_modifier.application_rule: TIME modifier. effective_rate = base_rate / modifier. Applies ONLY to qt_scaled tasks WITHOUT rates_by_tier (those tasks pre-embed the QT effect). COATING pool only.

height_modifier.source: Research: CD-008 height. DIRECT transfer from NC MOD_CABT_HEIGHT.
height_modifier.does_not_apply_to: Door/drawer tasks (painted flat on sawhorses at ground level), interior tasks, hardware tasks, FIXED tasks, floor protection
height_modifier.application_rule: TIME modifier. effective_rate = base_rate / height_modifier. Frame tasks only — doors/drawers at ground level.

kitchen_complexity_modifier.source: Research: CD-009 kitchen_complexity. DIRECT transfer from NC MOD_CABT_KITCHEN_COMPLEXITY.
kitchen_complexity_modifier.does_not_apply_to: Door/drawer tasks (removed, painted separately), interior tasks, FIXED assessment tasks

complex.description: U-shaped with island, multiple corner cabinets.

very_complex.description: Large custom kitchen with multiple zones, butler's pantry.

ROUND_CBRP_PRIME_2FINISH.notes: Standard RP for FAIR/POOR or non-latex existing finish.

ROUND_CBRP_2FINISH.notes: GOOD condition, sound latex, no prime.

ROUND_CBRP_PRIME_3FINISH.notes: QT5 brush + FAIR/POOR. Maximum coat sequence.

maximum_theoretical_prep.note: EXCEEDS 4.0x — extremely rare. Flag for estimator review. POOR condition cabinets genuinely require 2.5x+ prep effort.

maximum_theoretical_coating.note: Under 4.0x — valid. Identical to NC maximum.

realistic_maximum_doors_prep.note: Door tasks not affected by height or kitchen_complexity. Under 4.0x.

realistic_maximum_doors_coating.note: Modest stacking for door coating tasks.

realistic_maximum_frames_prep.note: Frame tasks not affected by door_style. Exceeds 4.0x — flag for review.

modifier_stacking_validation.flag_note: Prep pool stacking can exceed 4.0x in extreme scenarios because condition_scale adds a dimension not present in NC. This is expected and acceptable — POOR condition cabinets in extra-tall, very complex kitchens genuinely require extended prep time.

estimation_notes.four_item_types: 4 paintable items: ITM_CABINET_DOOR (EA), ITM_CABINET_DRAWER (EA), ITM_CABINET_FRAME (SF), ITM_CABINET_INTERIOR (SF conditional). Mixed UOM structure carries over from NC.
estimation_notes.spray_vs_brush: Spray is strongly preferred. Spray ~1.4-2.0x faster. Finish coat tasks split by method. Prime tasks split by method. Interstage/assessment tasks are method-independent. Transfers from NC.
estimation_notes.drawer_vs_door: Drawer fronts ~0.7x door time per unit. Ratio transfers from NC.
estimation_notes.interior_independence: Cabinet interiors always QT3 regardless of exterior tier (AWI semi-exposed standard). Always spray. Conditional on scope=full_with_interior.
estimation_notes.door_independence: Door/drawer tasks NOT affected by height or kitchen_complexity modifiers. Removed and painted flat on sawhorses at ground level.
estimation_notes.cure_time_constraint: 5-7 day minimum (7-14 days waterborne alkyd at QT4). Calendar days, not work hours. Identical to NC.
estimation_notes.two_mobilizations: Visit 1: assess/prep/prime/finish/cure setup. Visit 2: reinstall/touchup/cleanup. Identical to NC.

rp_vs_nc_key_differences.assessment_phase: 6 tasks, 100% RP-NEW. Condition inspect, adhesion test, coating ID, moisture check, thermofoil gate, lead screen.
rp_vs_nc_key_differences.prep_phase: Degloss replaces NC sand (~0.75-0.85x NC sand rates on existing finish). Grease wash replaces dust clean (~1.6x time). Damage repair replaces NC fill tasks. Caulk is assess/replace vs full.
rp_vs_nc_key_differences.prime_phase: 4 state-driven primer systems (vs NC 7 substrate-driven). Post-primer adhesion test is RP quality gate.
rp_vs_nc_key_differences.hardware_removal: ~30% slower than NC (painted-over hardware requires scoring).
rp_vs_nc_key_differences.cleanup_phase: Adds hinge adjustment, contents replacement, customer walkthrough.

rate_derivation_summary.direct_transfers: ~38 tasks — NC rates re-keyed TSK_CABT_* to TSK_CBRP_*. All finish, interstage, reinstall, protection teardown, vacuum, tool cleanup tasks.
rate_derivation_summary.modified_rates: ~14 tasks — NC base with RP adjustments. Degloss (~0.75-0.85x NC sand), hardware removal (~0.69x NC), grease wash (~1.6x NC dust clean), caulk assess (~1.38x NC full caulk per LF).
rate_derivation_summary.rp_new_rates: ~23 tasks — Assessment (6), chemical degloss (1), scrape/feather/damage repair (3), mildew/smoke treatment (2), adhesion test gate (1), hinge adjust (1), contents replace (1), customer walkthrough (1), verify contents empty (1), RRP shared (5).

estimation_notes.no_dry_times: Per RC-004: no dry times specified. Key constraint: 16-24 hour recoat for waterborne alkyd (BM Advance at QT4).
estimation_notes.pricing_structure: Cabinet RP priced as PACKAGE per kitchen/room, not per individual task.

assumptions.source: Research RF-016: RP degloss ~0.80x NC sand. Harder existing finish (120-150 grit vs 180-220). Cross-referenced with door RP degloss patterns.
Research: RP degloss ~0.78x NC sand. Existing semi-gloss/gloss finish harder to degloss than bare wood to sand.
Research: ~0.75x NC sand rate. ~0.7x door degloss time (smaller surface).
RP-NEW. Light scuff only (always QT3). Interior surfaces less exposed. Between NC sand rate (175 SF/hr) and NC prime interior rate (175 SF/hr) — light scuff is faster than either.
Research: ~30% slower than NC. Painted-over hardware requires scoring paint around hinges/screws. ~2.5 min per piece vs NC ~1.7 min.

assumptions.value: 40 min FIXED (vs NC dust clean 25 min)
assumptions.source: Research: ~1.6x NC dust clean time. TSP/degreaser wash with multiple passes and white cloth verification is fundamentally heavier than construction dust wipe.
Research CD-001: Cabinet POOR is higher multiplier because failure remediation involves 4 item types across different orientations (frames vertical, doors/drawers horizontal).
Research RF-017: Walk-and-assess is faster per LF than full application. Only 15-30% of joints typically need replacement.
Research: Apply liquid sander, allow dwell time, wipe off. ~6 min per door/drawer. Supplemental to mechanical degloss.
Research FM-009: ~4 min per door. Modern Euro hinges have 3-axis adjustment. More critical in RP than NC due to accumulated paint thickness.

assumptions.value: Condition 20-40 min, Adhesion 12 min, Coating ID 12 min, Moisture 8 min, Thermofoil 12 min, Lead 10 min
assumptions.source: Calibrated from door RP assessment patterns (TSK_DIRP_ASSESS_*) scaled for room-level cabinet assessment with multiple component types.

assumptions.value: Lead test 8 EA/hr, Containment setup 2 EA/hr, HEPA vacuum 4 EA/hr, Containment removal 3 EA/hr, Waste disposal 20 min FIXED
